passage:
Tuesday, late. We fought at breakfast over the electricity bill. I said Swati never checks anything; Swati said I sigh at everything. Both a little true, which made it worse. I left with my jaw tight. At lunch I found a sticky note in my bag: a drawing of a very sad potato and the words "sorry for the sigh comment." I laughed so loudly at my desk that a colleague looked over. I texted back: sorry for the never-checks thing too. Bill is on the fridge, let's look together tonight 😊. Swati replied with a potato wearing a crown. The bill isn't sorted, but my shoulders came down. Tonight: bill, tea, no scorekeeping.

Neelam

qa.q: What did the sticky note in Neelam's bag show?
qa.a: A drawing of a very sad potato with the words "sorry for the sigh comment."

qa.q: How did Neelam feel about the fight after finding the note, and what in the entry shows it?
qa.a: Neelam felt lighter and warmer, shown by the loud laugh at the desk and the shoulders that came down. 🙂

qa.q: Why does Neelam's reply help, even though the bill is still unsorted?
qa.a: Neelam apologised for their own part and suggested looking at the bill together, so repair started before the problem was solved.

qa.q: How might Swati have felt while drawing the potato?
qa.a: Swati probably felt bad about the sigh remark and wanted to soften things, and the crowned potato reply suggests relief that the joke landed. 🤍

grounding: Shows a spouse repairing quickly after a fight with a funny note, a mutual apology and a plan to look at the bill together.

passage:
Chaitanya: still angry?
Gopika: a bit. you forgot we had dinner booked AND you shouted when I reminded you
Chaitanya: I did. I'm sorry. I was stressed about the audit and took it out on you 🙏
Gopika: ok
Chaitanya: can I try again tonight? I rebooked the same place. 8:30
Gopika: that place was fully booked
Chaitanya: I begged. I told them my marriage depended on it
Gopika: you did not
Chaitanya: I told them it was an emergency paneer situation
Gopika: 😄
Gopika: fine. 8:30. you're paying and you're not checking your phone once
Chaitanya: phone stays in the car. promise
Gopika: and next time you're stressed, just say "I'm stressed" instead of shouting
Chaitanya: deal. I'm stressed. I love you
Gopika: ❤️ see you at 8:30

qa.q: What time did Chaitanya rebook the dinner for?
What was Chaitanya feeling while writing the apology?
qa.a: Chaitanya felt guilty and sorry for shouting, and anxious to repair things with Gopika quickly.

qa.q: Which small gestures helped them repair after the fight?
qa.a: A clear apology, rebooking the dinner, a joke that made Gopika laugh, and a promise to keep the phone away.

qa.q: What would change if Chaitanya had waited days to apologise?
qa.a: Gopika's hurt might have hardened into resentment, and the repair would have been much harder than a quick apology and a joke.

grounding: Shows a married couple repairing quickly after a fight through apology, humour and small gestures.

passage:
In Aparna and Mukesh's small house on the edge of Mandya, the fight had been about the scooter. Mukesh had lent it to his friend without asking, and Aparna had to walk to the bank in the midday heat. They went to bed without speaking.

At six the next morning Aparna woke to the smell of ginger tea, which Mukesh never made. He handed her a steel tumbler. "Sorry. It was your scooter too. I should have asked."

She sipped it and made a face. "You put in too much sugar."

"I also put in too much apology."

She laughed despite herself. "Next time, ask."

"Next time I'll ask. And I'll drop you at the bank myself."

Jyoti, Mukesh's sister, came into the kitchen, took one look at them and said, "Oh good, you've made up. The silence yesterday was giving me a headache."

qa.q: What had Mukesh lent to his friend without asking?
qa.a: Mukesh had lent the scooter to his friend.

qa.q: What was Mukesh feeling when he made ginger tea the next morning?
qa.a: Mukesh felt sorry and a little nervous, wanting to repair the hurt quickly with a gesture and an apology.

qa.q: Why did the morning repair work well?
qa.a: Mukesh apologised clearly and early, used a small gesture and humour, and promised a change, so the fight didn't grow.

qa.q: What was the fight like for Jyoti?
qa.a: Jyoti found the silent house uncomfortable and was relieved when she saw they had made up.

grounding: Shows a married couple repairing quickly after a fight with a small gesture, humour and an apology.
